ITEM 1 | Golden-brown waffle-patterned square piece with deep grid pockets, crisp-looking edges, two sections visible (one left, one center-right), about 10 cm across each, sitting on the plate's lower left | 120
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown waffle-patterned piece, lower center, roughly 9 cm square with deep grid pockets and slightly darker browned edges, overlapping item 1 | 110
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown waffle-patterned piece, right-center, about 9 cm long, partly under the sausage rounds, lighter and slightly less crisp-looking than item 2 | 100
ITEM 4 | Scrambled-looking yellow-orange egg-like mixture with chunks, mottled orange and pale yellow, moist and soft, loosely clumped, spread over the upper center about 8 cm across, with green broccoli-like florets mixed in | 90
ITEM 5 | Broccoli-like green florets, dark green with some pale stems, scattered among and beneath the scrambled mixture on the left-center, about 4 cm across total | 15
ITEM 6 | Two or three white, soft, crumbly, slightly glossy blobs of cheese-like material with irregular edges, sitting on top of the scrambled mixture at upper left and center, roughly 6 cm across total | 45
ITEM 7 | Small cubes and wedges of roasted potato, golden-tan with browned, slightly crisp skin edges and pale interior, clustered at the bottom center, each piece about 2–3 cm | 60
ITEM 8 | Round sausage slices, dark reddish-brown with glossy, slightly browned surfaces and a firm texture, about 2.5 cm diameter and 1 cm thick, arranged in a curved line along the right side of the plate, about nine pieces | 90
ITEM 9 | Small cut pieces of dark reddish-brown sausage-like rounds, glossy and browned at the edges, near the center-right among the waffles, about 2.5 cm each | 15
ITEM 10 | Small white crumbs or flecks of soft cheese-like material on the white tabletop and plate edge at lower left, each under 1 cm | 3
